transcript_segments.text: Someone said, my words were salad, which is fair.
There were leaves, there were layers, there was dressing involved.
But I couldn't help thinking, maybe you were just looking for a sandwich.
I spent weeks folding feelings into strange little shapes, making paper birds out of things
I couldn't say then.
Someone came with the fork in their fists like mate.
This is confusing, where's the plate?
I said the plate is implied.
They said, that's the problem.
I said the problem is hungard dressed up.
As logic I wrote the moon has a bruise where the morning got in.
They said, what does that mean?
I said it means I was lonely.
They said, why not say that?
I said, because I was lonely.
Some people build houses, some people build tents, some leave notes and bottles, then complain
about rent me.
I build mazes with the door at the start and get offended when nobody studies the walls
and calls it art.
Maybe I hit too well, maybe I dressed the wound too fine, maybe I made a meal, then blamed
you for warning a sign.
If you see only salad, maybe you were looking for a sandwich, maybe I was speaking in
the dorms when you only packed a blanket.
If you couldn't find the meaning, maybe I buried it too deep, but don't call it empty.
Just because it made you reach.
Still, could've used less parsley.
I used to think being understood, men being reduced, like if I gave you the key, then
the room would be used like someone would walk through my head with muddy shoes, point
at the curtains and say, bit much.
Don't you think?
And maybe it is.
Maybe I put chandeliers and sheds, maybe I describe a headache, like a cathedral arguing
with bees.
Maybe I hit a whole confession in a slice of cake and called a liberation.
But listen, when you grow up explaining your face, your tone, your hands, your silence,
your reasons for standing too close, then too far away than nowhere anyone can reach.
You learn that plain speech is not always safer.
Sometimes, plain speeches are window, sometimes metaphor.
It's curtains, sometimes curtains are the only thing between you and everyone looking
in like they paid for a tour.
So yes, I served you, these bitter ones, strange ones, a few, I should've washed.
The pair was a pulse underneath, there was a table, there was a chair pulled out, there
was me trying badly to invite you somewhere.
If you see only salad.
Maybe you were looking for a sandwich.
Maybe I was speaking in storms when you only packed a blanket.
Yeah, if you couldn't find a meaning, maybe I'll be ready to do.
But don't call it empty.
Just because it made you reach.
And I get it.
Not every locked door is profound.
Sometimes it's just a locked door.
And every strange phrase is a treasure chest.
Sometimes it's just me panicking attractively.
Sometimes the truth looks cold all apart.
So I overdress it and call it art.
Sometimes I leave the door half open.
So the room can change with who walks in.
If I name every shadow too clearly, it stops belonging to anyone but me.
That's annoying.
Also useful.
You came looking for lunch and found a forest.
I came looking for praise and found a mirror wearing your disappointed face.
Maybe the next one gets a signpost.
Maybe the next one gets bread.
Maybe the next time I say grief without dressing it up as weather in my head.
Maybe I leave room for the listener without handing them a map.
I stop calling every open hand to trap.
But I won't flatten the hills just to make the walk polite.
I won't drain all the colors so the water looks right.
There's a place between mountains and overexplained.
Between look, cubby by am and please fill my pain off.
Trying to find it badly with herbs.
So if the line feels crooked, maybe sit with the bend.
If the meaning comes late, maybe wait for the end.
And if you still see salad, well fair enough, friend.
But I was feeding something.
I couldn't name them.
If you see only salad, maybe you were looking for a sandwich.
Maybe I was speaking in storms when you only packed a blanket.
If you couldn't find the meaning, maybe I buried it too deep.
But don't call it empty just because it made you reach.
If you see only salad, maybe I'll bring bread next time.
But I won't stop growing strange things in the garden of my mind.
So no hard feelings.
You want it simple.
I want it seen somewhere between the lettuce and the long.
We were both a little hungry.
